QuestInfo.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
QuestInfo.parent: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
QuestInfo.1: I met #p206#, who's been studying the monsters and animals around #m10001000#. His bright smile and easygoing demeanor belie the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time now. The reason he's been studying the mushroom monsters is to uncover clues as to his daughter's whereabouts. He asked if I could help him out, and I just couldn't say no to such a worthy cause...
QuestInfo.2: I helped #p206# gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?

0.0: Hey there, kid. Yes, you! I am a scientist that specializes in the field of monsters and animals in this world. If you have any time available, would you mind helping this old man out?

yes.0: Thank you. I have been studying the mushroom monsters, and--speaking of mushroom monsters, this reminds me of something.
yes.1: Years ago, my daughter and I went out of town in search of research materials. While we were busy excavating, we were ambushed by an enormous mushroom monster.
yes.2: By the time I regained consciousness, I had been severely battered and bruised, and my daughter was nowhere to be found. Ever since the incident, I have been studying mushroom monsters in hopes of finding some clues of my daughter's whereabouts.
yes.3: Oh, I'm rambling again. Anyway, I would appreciate it a great deal if you could hunt #r20 #o4#s#k and #r#o9#s#k and get me #b10 #t4000003#s#k and #b10 #t4000009#s#k. Thank you!

no.0: I would appreciate it a good deal if you could help me out, but alas, if you're busy...

1.0: You brought everything! Thank you, thank you! I shall start studying these samples carefully. Oh, I almost forgot to reward you for your hard work.

yes.0: Here's a small gift to you. This should help you on your journey. I'll see you around.

item.0: I don't think you've collected all the items I need. I need #b10 #t4000003#s#k and #b10 #t4000009#s#k.

mob.0: Don't forget to take down the monsters too.
